task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the red-orange text on white can, place it in the boxy light blue plasticbox, then pick the red soda can with green accents and place it in the boxy light blue plasticbox.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架后，挑选白色易拉罐上的红橙色文字，将其放入四四方方的浅蓝色塑料盒中，然后挑选带有绿色口音的红色汽水罐并将其放入四四方方的浅蓝色塑料盒中。
